record_kind: Independent administrative acceptance metadata; not a new S06 core object or issued GA/GRR

authority_basis.purpose_qualification_effect: This new exact administrative decision accepts only the unchanged STATUS purpose and existing Owner PR-merge signature algorithm for the specified Root generation 3 in the newly approved fixed window. It is not an in-place renewal of old generation 2 acceptance.

accepted_issuer_purposes.boundary: Only qualification status statements under their own accepted schema; cannot substitute for GateStatusProjection, authorization, GRR or a PASS.

signature_requirements: GitHub verified=true reason=valid, actual committer web-flow and Owner tdoljyj merge in exact private tdoljyj/cross-memory-system repository.
Exact payload/tree/blob and independent acceptance evidence must be checked. Owner prior merge is not a signature of a new object.
Purpose must match the specific consumer and Audience must match exactly. Signing the record does not prove controller qualification or the truth of any claimed result.
STATUS retains the exact original algorithm; a new-generation status object still requires its own accepted schema and actual signature. Prior-generation evidence is not its signature.
consumption: A RootSet qualification_ref may point to this exact immutable metadata blob. A consumer must select the matching purpose and exact Audience/subject/service/root scope and verify this actual acceptance plus the current registered RootSet and applicable object prerequisites. Missing/expired/revoked/unknown proof fails closed.
generation_applicability: Exact Root generation 3 only; not a Status object generation constraint, automatic inheritance or acceptance of old generation under new dates.
